Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by AirPods Pro 3 dropping even lower to the best price ever at $179 shipped (nearly 30% off) and all five AirPods Max 2 colors hitting the Amazon all-time low. We also have up to $300 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro models joined by Apple’s most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $200 off, the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models up to $130 off, and the upgraded 240W braided Beats USB-C cable down as low as $19. Head below for a closer look.

Hello! AirPods Pro 3 just dropped to the best price ever at $179 (Nearly 30% off)

Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3 are sure to be a popular pickup this month ahead of during Prime Day, but they have already dropped down to the lowest price we have tracked to date at $179 shipped.

Amazon is offering AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 shipped today, undercutting the recent early summer deal pricing by $20 to deliver a new all-time low.

Regularly $249, you’re looking at a solid $70 in savings to deliver nearly 30% in savings. Previous to today, the best price we had tracked online had them down in the $185 range for a very brief time when Amazon was price matching a Verizon offer – this deal was hard to lock down and constantly in and out of stock for the day or so it was live.

All five AirPods Max 2 colors have hit Amazon all-time low pricing

While we are still a couple weeks out from the official start of Prime Day 2026, with Father’s Day looming we are catching some all-time low pricing and now all five colors of the latest AirPods Max 2 have landed at the best prices to date.

Amazon is now offering the new AirPods Max 2 from $499 shipped. You will now find most colors at $499 and the purple set sitting just $1 higher at $499.99 shipped to deliver Amazon all-time low pricing across the board.

We caught this deal last week, but Amazon was only offering a couple colors down at the new low when the deal first went live. As of right now, however, all five options have hit the lowest Amazon price since Apple released its new, next-generation over-ear headphones.

Regularly $549, you’re looking at a solid $50 in savings here less than three months after debuting in Apple’s current-generation lineup.

While we did see a color and USB-C refresh previously, the new AirPods Max 2 are effectively the first next-generation set of Apple headphones to date. Carrying Apple’s H2 chip, they feature a new high dynamic range amp for enhanced sound quality alongside upgraded ANC and Transparency modes – “up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation,” according to Apple.

Dive into our AirPods Max 2 review for a closer look at the feature set and what’s new this time around.

Amazon now offering $200 off 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but this 48GB model is $300 off

Amazon has just dropped the price on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro to deliver a solid $200 off the list price. Just keep in mind, there are some configs with 48GB of RAM you can score right now for $100 less than that. Details below.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB storage capacity down at $2,399 shipped this morning.

This is a regularly $2,599 configuration with the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU joined by the upgraded 2TB of internal storage at $200 off the list price.

However, B&H is still offering a series of 48GB M5 Pro configurations with 1TB of storage at $300 off the list price, one of which you can score for $100 less than the Amazon deal above:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,299 (Reg. $2,599)
  • 15-Core CPU/16-Core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,499 (Reg. $2,799)
  • 18-Core CPU/20-Core GPU
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 64GB/1TB $2,999 (Reg. $3,299)

Now clearly Amazon’s deal features double the storage, and it’s up to you how valuable that is compared to the RAM. But as anyone who has followed my MacBook coverage will already know, I tend to favor the RAM upgrades far more and these B&H offers deliver some tempting options with double the memory:

The first option is the 48GB/1TB with the same 15-Core CPU/16-Core GPU setup at $100 less than the Amazon deal above, and the second has the 48GB/1TB with the upgraded 18-Core CPU/20-Core GPU for $100 more. It’s a tough call, but unless you really want/need the 2TB of storage, I would think the B&H offers here will deliver better overall value even if the Amazon machine was closer to its $2,341 all-time low.

Apple’s most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air sitting at Amazon all-time low pricing ($200 off)

There were plenty of $150 price drops live oover the last few days on the M5 MacBook Air lineup, but Amazon is still offering this Midnight 15-inch configuration at $200 off the list to match the lowest price we have tracked.

We got a good run of $200 price drops across the 2026 Air lineup over the last couple weeks, but prices have jumped back up on just about all of them at this point save for this 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity at $1,099 shipped.

You’re looking at Apple’s entry and most affordable 15-inch Midnight treatment sitting down at the lowest price we have tracked to date. And considering just about everything else has jumped back up in price at this point, chances are this same $200 price drop is going to be where everything lands during Prime Day later this month – Amazon typically brings prices back up right before major sales and then back down to the previous lows, especially when it comes to current-generation MacBook models.

Apple Watch Series 11 back to all-time lows: $100 off base models, $130 off GPS + Cell (All colors)

We are started to catch the return of all-time low pricing on Apple Watch Series 11 over this past weekend, but now all colors on the most popular models are back to the best prices to date. You’ll find the 42mm models from $299 with the same $100 price drop on the base 46mm, and now all colors of the GPS + Cell model are $130 off as well.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $299 (Reg. $399) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $329 (Reg. $429) – All colors
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529) – All colors

As you can see above, Amazon is now delivering the all-time low pricing all four models of the base aluminum case variants and now you’ll find these prices on all four colors of each as well – Jet Black, Silver, Space Gray, and Rose Gold.

You’re looking at a solid $100 off for the GPS-only variants, but we are once again tracking that particularly notable deal on the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell models at $130 off the list price – it is now sitting at the same price as the comparable and typically less expensive 42mm.

Extra $5 to $10 off already discounted Apple accessories: USB-C cables, Thunderbolt 5, MagSafe 3, more from $4

Woot has now refreshed its official Apple accessory sale, and this time it is offering an extra $5 off the already reduced prices using code APPLEWOOT at checkout. New customers will receive an extra $10 off using the same code. We are looking at already discounted Apple USB-C cables and MagSafe 3 charging cables as well Thunderbolt 5 leads, Apple Watch chargers, and more. All of the eligible items are waiting on this landing page and we will take a closer look below.

One notable deal in the sale has Apple’s official 1-meter Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable marked down to $46.99 with free shipping for Prime members (a $6 delivery fee will apply otherwise). However, using code APPLEWOOT your total will drop down to $41.99, or as low as $36.99 if you’re a new Woot customer. Regularly $69, this is at least 40% off and the best price we can find.

This cable is currently up at the full $69 on Amazon where it is basically never on sale.
